thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: node/gpu-pool-12 reporting rapid PodEviction events (kubelet). Disk usage on /var/lib/model-cache > 93%. Suspected log blowup + large file churn.

oncall-sre: acked. paging now. assigning @thom (primary) and @maria (secondary).

thom: I'm on it. first step: capture `kubectl describe node gpu-pool-12` and `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-pool-12` then tail kubelet logs.

thom: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-pool-12` shows a bunch of model-serving pods in CrashLoopBackOff and some `OOMKilled`. A few runtime pods show `Evicted` with reason "DiskPressure".

thom: grabbing logs from one runtime pod:
```
I0324 12:14:03.123 kubelet eviction manager: nodefs.available < eviction threshold
serve-runtime: fatal: cudaInit failed: out of memory
... model-cache: failed to open mmap: file too large
```

maria: also seeing a ~8GB logfile for `redis-kv-logger` in /var/log/inference which rotated incorrectly. logrotate doesn't seem to be running inside that sidecar.

dev-runtime: we shipped a debug-level trace last deploy that accidentally left verbose logging enabled on kv-logger. that explains the log bloat. switching to INFO immediately. rolling patch now.

oncall-sre: customer impact? any 5xx spikes?

ana-cs: cc @ana-cs: monitoring shows an increase in 5xx and 504 errors for a subset of hosted inference endpoints starting ~12:10 UTC. two customers (acme-ai, beta-saas) report degraded throughput. I'm drafting a status note.

thom: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon gpu-pool-12 2) attempt to free disk by truncating largest log files and clearing model cache temp dirs 3) restart kubelet if safe 4) drain non-critical pods.

thom: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-12` -> done.

thom: truncating files: `sudo truncate -s 0 /var/log/inference/redis-kv-logger.log` and `rm -f /var/lib/model-cache/tmp/*` (careful). freeing ~22GB.

dev-runtime: confirm patch pushed to kv-logger to reduce verbosity, creating image `kv-logger:stable+fix-rot`. recommend rolling sidecar replacement rather than full pod replace to preserve in-flight sessions.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout inference/kv-logger sidecar -> 7/12 pods updated.

thom: after truncation, node disk pressure eased a bit. however two GPU pods still show CUDA errors on restart (cudaInit timeout). suspect the OOM from earlier left GPUs in a bad state; restarting runtime container may not be sufficient.

maria: planning to drain non-critical stateful pods to prevent re-evictions during recovery. running: `kubectl drain gpu-pool-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 --force` starting.

dev-runtime: for the CUDA errors, we see driver warnings: "NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus" on one node — looks like node-level driver flakiness coincident with heavy IO. might restart node-level pod infra or escalate to infra.

thom: I'm escalating to eng-infra now — @eng-infra please look at node gpu-pool-12 hardware state and driver health.

eng-infra (via thread): investigating. host shows high i/o wait during eviction period, and nvidia-driver reported a firmware glitch on GPU0. planning a reboot of the host after pods drained.

ana-cs: status update to customers: "We are experiencing degraded performance for some hosted inference endpoints due to node storage pressure that caused pod evictions. Our SREs are actively mitigating; we will update in 30 minutes." :white_check_mark:

thom: drain completed, most model-serving pods rescheduled onto other nodes. freed additional 40GB on gpu-pool-12. preparing to reboot node to clear driver state.

maria: handoff note: I'm taking 30min watch to ensure rescheduled pods are healthy and that the kv-logger rollout finishes. if anything re-evicts or errors persist, I'll page infra S2.

dev-runtime: rollout complete: `kv-logger:stable+fix-rot` rolled to all replicas. logging rate back to normal. added immediate mitigations: reduced trace to INFO, re-enabled logrotate cron with tighter retention.

eng-infra: reboot scheduled and executed at 12:48 UTC. node came back up clean, driver loaded, GPU accessible.

thom: post-reboot checks: model-serving back to steady state, 5xx errors trending down to baseline. marking incident as mitigated for now.

ana-cs: sent follow-up customer note: "Services are recovering; some requests may have seen transient failures. Full RCA will be posted after SRE/Runtime teams complete analysis."

maria: action items for RCA: 1) audit deploy that enabled verbose logging 2) add alert for single large logfile (/var/log/* > 1GB) 3) ensure logrotate runs in sidecars or centralize logs sooner 4) revisit eviction thresholds for model-cache path 5) add node-level driver-failure detection to infra pager.

thom: thanks everyone. handing to @maria for post-incident monitoring & RCA coordination.

maria: taking handoff. leaving timeline + notes in the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. oncall: maria. severity: Sev2.
